comment: Laya contract for the cloud voice session controls (CV-A). Not a workspace manifest: these verbs act on the call itself, so they sit outside the workspace UI-action audit. tests/unit/test_live_session_plan.py holds each verb to a live voice tool, its gate class and its ring.

phrasings: you don't need all those tools
verbs.effect: narrows the declared set at the next reconnect; nothing leaves the machine
declares every tool at the next reconnect
adds one tool group at the next reconnect

phrasings: how much has this call cost?
what has this call cost so far?
how much have I spent on voice today?
verbs.effect: reads the call's metered cost and today's voice total; sends nothing

held_out_eval.text: can you stop using so many tools
okay now give me the whole toolbox
